title: Rooftop Flow
blurb: A six-section rooftop time trial with vaults, slides and wall jumps.

verification.notes: Stands on the start roof. Sprinting without jumping runs off into the 13 m first gap and now falls and respawns at the start (~3.3 s), repeating while W is held. Fixed in round 1: previously hung against the next building's face with no respawn.

fixRounds.issue: Falling into the first gap (sprint, no jump) left the player hanging against the next building's face for 6+ s with no respawn; soft-lock without R.
